arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-01' AND date < '2020-02-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated from 1 October 2019 through 31 January 2020. The data ends on 31 October 2019, so this is the count for October 2019 only.
assumptions: The data covers only 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31. The requested period is partly outside it, so the count covers 2019-10-01 to 2019-10-31 only; November 2019 to January 2020 has no data.
The count includes all transactions, whether or not they have a fraud label.
Transactions with negative amounts are included, since the question asks for transactions and does not exclude them.
